meta.title: Remote Access Gateway
meta.description: Protect and publish a loopback-only DSH Web GUI through authenticated LAN, Tailscale, or tunnel access.

dsh-remote-access.title: Remote Access Gateway
dsh-remote-access.summary: Manage LAN, Tailscale, and public-tunnel access. Every external request passes through the login gateway.
dsh-remote-access.safetyBody: Do not expose DSH's original port directly. Publish only this gateway and require HTTPS for public access.
dsh-remote-access.lanNotFound: No usable LAN IPv4 address was detected.
dsh-remote-access.tailscaleNotFound: No usable Tailscale address was detected.
dsh-remote-access.tailscaleNotInstalled: Tailscale is not installed, or its command is not on PATH.
dsh-remote-access.tailscaleDisconnected: Tailscale is installed but not connected.
dsh-remote-access.tunnelBody: Configure a provider before starting or restarting the tunnel. Revoking sessions signs out every remote device.
dsh-remote-access.tunnelNeedsConfiguration: No tunnel provider is configured. Complete the tunnel settings in the configuration file first.
dsh-remote-access.initializePasswordBody: No current password is required the first time. Set a password of at least 10 characters to enable remote access.
dsh-remote-access.changePasswordBody: Verify the current password, save its replacement, and revoke all remote sessions.
dsh-remote-access.passwordTooShort: The new password must be at least 10 characters.
dsh-remote-access.passwordChanged: Password changed. All remote sessions were revoked.
dsh-remote-access.configurationBody: Saving applies these settings through DSH configuration. LAN and Tailscale modes listen on all network interfaces.
dsh-remote-access.trustedProxyCidrs: Trusted proxy IP/CIDR entries (one per line)
dsh-remote-access.frpToken: New FRP token (leave blank to keep current)
dsh-remote-access.frpStcpSecret: New STCP secret (leave blank to keep current)
